fact: In the Banco de Cabo Verde's payment system report for 2024, televinti4 (the vinti4 card wallet app) ran 772,231 operations worth 8,447.7 million escudos, and a five-month pilot of the STII instant and inclusive transfer system with four commercial banks and SISP had been carried out; the vinti4 network is the country's only shared network.
title: Sistema de Pagamentos: canais digitais registam crescimento significativo em 2024
